title: Born
notes: Frank arrives in the world, one of Ducky's litter. Orange, opinionated, roughly the size of a russet potato.

title: FIXbend clinic visit
notes: First clinic visit, Bend OR. Cost: $0.00.

title: DAPP vaccine, first dose
notes: Given at FIXbend. Needs boosters, which FIXbend cannot administer.

title: Home with Steve
notes: Came home from Arlo's camp, waving goodbye to mama Ducky. Van life begins. Date per the gotcha-day photos.

title: The crate becomes the den
notes: Frank enters the crate voluntarily. Treat tossed in, calm energy, den instinct doing the rest.

title: Zero daytime accidents
notes: The structured crate / awake / potty cycle is working. Overnight stretches now run 3 to 4 hours.

title: The Great Zipper Escape
notes: Frank worked out the crate door zipper. A carabiner now stands guard.

title: DAPP booster #2
notes: Given at Sunriver Veterinary Clinic (Dr. Lauren Salgo). The 9-week visit also covered dewormer and Bordetella, per her puppy schedule sheet.

title: Off to Amy's
notes: Care handoff. The care guide PDF and the signed authorization letter travel with him.

title: 12-week visit: DAPP #3 + lepto #1
notes: Per Dr. Salgo's puppy schedule: DHPP booster, first leptospirosis dose, dewormer.

title: 16-week visit: DAPP #4 + lepto #2 + rabies
notes: Per Dr. Salgo's puppy schedule: final DHPP, second leptospirosis dose, rabies, dewormer. Completes the puppy series.

title: Neuter
notes: Dr. Salgo's schedule sheet says around 6 months.
